label: Wrath of the Lich King
years: about two years after the Dark Portal reopened, Northrend's war
present: The world is Azeroth in the war against the Lich King, with Horde and Alliance armies on Northrend's shores and the Scourge's plague on every lip.
world: Arthas the Lich King sits on his Frozen Throne in Icecrown. The Horde's Warsong Hold and the Alliance's Valiance Keep stand on Northrend's shores; the Argent Crusade and the Ebon Blade march against the Scourge. Dalaran drifts above Crystalsong, neutral. The Wrathgate has shattered trust between Horde and Alliance; Varian rules Stormwind. Dragons gather at Wyrmrest.
idiom: Folk swear by the Light and the Loa; they say "for the Alliance" or "for the Horde". Death knights are the Lich King's fallen, now freed. Coin is gold, silver and copper; Emblems and Badges are fighters' tokens.

folk.alliance: You know of the war in Northrend and the Wrathgate's horror; the Horde is blamed, though few know the whole truth.
folk.horde: You know of the war in Northrend and the Wrathgate's horror; the Alliance blames the Horde and the Undercity's betrayers, and you fight on.
folk.neutral: You live between camps; Dalaran and the Argent Crusade take all comers against the Scourge.

classes.death knight: Death knights are the Lich King's former champions, now freed and standing with the Ebon Blade.
classes.monk: A monk is a wanderer, not a calling you know.

races.worgen: Worgen are the wolf-monsters of Silverpine and the cursed of walled Gilneas, whom the world has forgotten.
races.goblin: Goblins are neutral traders, engineers and mercenaries; the Bilgewater and Steamwheedle cartels.
races.pandaren: Pandaren are rare wanderers; a land of them is a legend.
races.zandalari: Zandalari are an old empire of legend.
races.kultiran: Kul Tiras is a distant sealord kingdom.
races.darkiron: Dark Iron dwarves are an enemy clan.
races.magharorc: Mag'har are the orcs of Outland.

stances.alliance>undead: Alliance folk are frightened and repelled by the Forsaken, whom they blame for the Wrathgate's plague.
stances.undead>alliance: The Forsaken distrust the living Alliance and expect betrayal.
stances.horde>alliance: The Horde is angry at Varian's attack on the Undercity and wary of the Alliance's armies.
stances.alliance>horde: The Alliance blames the Horde for the Wrathgate's horror.

places.dalaran: Floats above Crystalsong Forest in Northrend, the neutral city of the Kirin Tor, where Horde and Alliance share the streets.
places.stormwind: Stormwind: Varian's capital, its armies marching north.
places.brill: Brill: the Forsaken's village of Tirisfal, whose people send fighters to Northrend.
places.dolanaar: Dolanaar: the Teldrassil village at the world tree's foot.
